sentences.text: He further submits that applicant and prosecutrix were engaged however, their marriage couldn't be performed.
He also referred to a portion of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. wherein she stated that on account of pressure from her paternal aunt, their marriage broke off.
3. Issue notice.
4. Learned APP for the State accepts the notice and seeks time to file a Status Report.

He however,
on instructions, submits that on a prima facie examination, no video of any incident was found in the applicant's seized mobile phone and the same has been sent to FSL.
He seeks time to file a Status Report.
